title: Why Girls Can't Pee Alone | Iliza Shlesinger  #standupcomedy #comedy
description:
Iliza Shlesinger breaks down the unspoken rule every woman knows and every man is confused by, the bathroom buddy system. One girl says she has to pee and suddenly the whole group drops everything to go with her. A dead-on bit from her stand-up special War Paint, live on Laugh Society.
